description: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has urged TCS subsidiary HyperVault to inaugurate its planned Hyderabad AI data centre by June 2, 2028, after the company announced an investment of up to Rs 70,000 crore.
body_lead: Telangana Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy on Saturday urged TCS’ HyperVault to inaugurate its AI Data Centre in Hyderabad by June 2, 2028. "Our state formation day is June 2. Ground breaking to inauguration, there are 21 months from today. We want to inaugurate your AI data centre on June 2, 2028," he said. He assured the company of giving all required sanctions.
